PART A - NO CALCULATOR
1. Solve for x: 3x + 7 =
22.
A) 3          B) 5
C) 7          D) 29/3
2. What are the solutions of
x2 − 5x + 6 = 0?
A) x = 2 or x = 3    B) x = −2 or x = −3
C) x = 1 or x = 6    D) x = −1 or x = −6
3. Solve x2 − 9 = 0.
A) x = 9   B) x = 3 only   C) x = 3 or x = −3   D) x = 81
4. Which expression is equivalent to
(2x3)(4x2)?
A) 6x5    B) 8x6
C) 6x6    D) 8x5
5. Evaluate 2⁻³.
A) −8   B) −6   C) 1/6   D) 1/8
6. What is the vertex of y = (x − 4)2 + 1?
A) (−4, 1)   B) (4, 1)
C) (4, −1)   D) (1, 4)

- 1 -
7. Solve 2x2 + 3x − 2 = 0.
A) x = −1/2 or x = 2    B) x = 1 or x = −2
C) x = 1/2 or x = −2    D) x = 2 or x = 1/2
8. Factor completely: x2 + 7x + 12.
A) (x + 2)(x + 6)   B) (x − 3)(x − 4)
C) (x + 1)(x + 12)  D) (x + 3)(x + 4)
9. The graph of a parabola is shown below. Which equation could it repre-
sent?
[Figure: parabola opening downward, vertex (0, 3)]
A) y = x2 + 3    B) y = −x2 + 3
C) y = −x2 − 3   D) y = x2 − 3
10. Simplify x8 / x2.
A) x4   B) x6   C) x10   D) 6x
11. What is the discriminant of x2 + 4x + 7?
A) −12   B) 12   C) 44   D) −44
12. Solve 5(x − 2) = 3x + 4.
A) 3   B) −7   C) 7   D) 1
13. Solve x2 + 2x − 15 = 0 by factoring. Show your
work. [6 pts]
14. Let f(x) = x2 − 6x + 5. [8 pts]
(a) Find the zeros of f. [3 pts]
(b) Write f in vertex form. [3 pts]
(c) State the minimum value of f. [2 pts]

PART B - CALCULATOR
15. What is 18% of 250?
A) 4.5   B) 45   C) 450   D) 13.9
16. $2,000 is invested at 5% per year, compounded annually. What is it
worth after 3 years? Round to the nearest cent.
A) $2,300.00   B) $2,315.25
C) $2,310.00   D) $6,000.00
17. A population of 1,200 bacteria doubles every 3 hours. How many bac-
teria are there after 12 hours?
A) 4,800   B) 9,600   C) 19,200   D) 14,400
18. Solve 4x − 9 = 2x + 15.
A) 3   B) 12   C) 6   D) −12
19. Find the mean of 12, 15, 9, 20, 14.
A) 14   B) 15   C) 12   D) 70
20. A car worth $24,000 loses 15% of its value each year. Which expression
gives its value after t years?
A) 24000(1.15)t    B) 24000(0.15)t
C) 24000 − 0.15t   D) 24000(0.85)t
21. Solve x2 − 2x − 8 = 0.
A) x = −4 or x = 2   B) x = 4 or x = −2
C) x = 8 or x = −1   D) x = 2 or x = 4
22. Use the table below. What is the average rate of change of g from x = 1 to x = 3?
x | 1 | 2 | 3
g(x) | 4 | 10 | 22
A) 18   B) 6   C) 11   D) 9
23. A ball is thrown upward. Its height in feet after t seconds is
h(t) = −16t2 + 64t + 80. [8 pts]
(a) Find h(2). [2 pts]
(b) After how many seconds does the ball hit the ground? [4 pts]
(c) What is the maximum height of the ball? [2 pts]

lated to the graph of y = x2. Then sketch both graphs on the grid provided. [10 pts]
